# Every pull request shows how it was verified

## Context

Reviewers could not tell what an author had run before opening a pull request.

## Decision

A pull request is opened only after the ticket's verify command has passed, and its body shows the command and
its result. The team keeps the exact steps as conventions under this decision.

## Consequences

Agents and people run the verify command before they open a pull request, not after CI fails.
